0.0: Hello, there? You look quite familiar... if I'm not mistaken, aren't you the one that showed me Dr. Kim's blueprint the other day? Am I right? Haha... no one can beat me in terms of remembering people. The problem is, I have really a hard time remembering DIRECTIONS, and thus, I get lost very easily...
0.1: Can you help me out? My current mission is to track the #r#o4240000##k, but I keep getting los-I mean, they keep thowing me off the trail! They have a #b#t4000125##k that I need 20 of. The last time I saw them was around #bKulan Field#k.

1.0: I knew you were more than capable of handling the task! And this is a real #b#t4000125##k... This should be enough. I can't just let you go empty-handed after what you've done. Here, take some supplies from the command center. I insist!

yes.0: How do you like the #b100 #t2020008#s#k? I better start chasing #o4240000# with the newly-received #b#t4000125##k, right now. These guys are difficult to find, and they seem to pop up everywhere, so this should be a life-saver for me. I gotta get to work now, so if you'll excuse me...

item.0: I'm having the worst time keeping up with the #b#o4240000##k, so please track them down and get their #b#t4000125##k. I need about 20. Maybe start looking around #bKulan Field#k?

QuestInfo.name: Chief Gray's Sign
QuestInfo.1: You've regrouped with Gunny near Omega Sector. Gunny is on a mission to track Chief Grays, but he kept getting lost instead. Take care of the Chief Grays for Gunny and bring him 20 of their signs.
QuestInfo.2: I collected Chief Gray's signs and gave them to Gunny, who's at a field around Omega Sector. With this sign, Gunny may be able to have an easier time tracing Chief Gray.
